codeReview.summary: Clean implementation of query_ref() using UnsafeCell interior mutability on World.storage. Three hot-path conversion sites (renderer collect_draws, editor collect_entity_info, scene save) correctly switched from entity_ids()+get_component() loops to query()/query_ref(). Seven tests cover correctness and performance. One tangential NDC Y-axis fix in editor unproject is well-tested. The UnsafeCell soundness concern for query_ref is a known limitation without compile-time enforcement but is acceptable for this codebase.

issues.description: query_ref() accepts any QueryData type including &mut T, but the SAFETY comment states mutable queries would be unsound. There is no compile-time guard preventing world.query_ref::<&mut SomeComponent>() from being called. This is an API footgun — a caller could accidentally trigger UB. A future improvement would be to add a separate QueryDataRef marker trait or use a type-state pattern to restrict query_ref to immutable-only access. Not blocking since no call sites use mutable query_ref, and the doc comment documents the restriction.

UnsafeCell<ComponentStorageManager> makes World !Sync. This is acceptable since World is never shared across threads (no Arc<World> usage found), but it should be noted in case future multi-threading is planned. No Send/Sync impls were added, so this is the default UnsafeCell behavior and is correct.

Tangential change: NDC Y-axis calculation in unproject_to_ground_plane_impl was flipped from negating Y to not negating Y. The comment explains this is for Windows top-down swapchain. This change is well-tested (5 existing unit tests verify unproject behavior) and is a bug fix rather than query conversion work. Including bug fixes in feature commits is a minor style concern but not blocking.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The World struct uses UnsafeCell<ComponentStorageManager> to support query_ref(&self). This is an important architectural detail for anyone working on World internals. Future workers modifying World should know that storage access always goes through UnsafeCell::get() or get_mut().
sharedStateObservations.evidence: katla_ecs/src/world.rs:34-37 — UnsafeCell wrapping with safety documentation
sharedStateObservations.suggestedContent: World.storage is wrapped in UnsafeCell<ComponentStorageManager> to support query_ref() (immutable queries from &self). All storage access goes through self.storage.get() (unsafe, &self) or self.storage.get_mut() (safe, &mut self). query_ref() is sound only for immutable QueryData types (&T, (&T, &U), etc.). Mutable queries through query_ref would be UB but are not prevented at compile time.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The old pub(crate) field World.storage and its getter methods storage()/storage_mut() were removed. A new pub storage_mut() method was added. This changes the public API surface of World.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: katla_ecs/src/world.rs:70-73 — new storage_mut() replaces old pub(crate) field access
sharedStateObservations.suggestedContent: World no longer exposes storage as a pub(crate) field. Use world.storage_mut(&mut self) for direct ComponentStorageManager access. The old storage() getter that returned &ComponentStorageManager was removed. query_ref(&self) provides immutable iteration from shared references.

summary: Query conversion feature is well-implemented. The UnsafeCell-based query_ref() correctly enables read-only queries from shared references. All three hot-path sites (renderer, editor, scene save) were properly converted. Seven tests cover correctness (query matches manual loop, mut propagation, empty world, component filtering, query_ref equivalence) and performance (event emission and change detection overhead). The only notable concern is that query_ref does not prevent mutable queries at the type level, but this is documented and no call sites misuse it. Tangential NDC Y-axis fix is correct. Status: PASS.
